context:
These are follow-ups from #2972 (platform options reach adapters) and #2974 (deployment modes). Extend the per-platform parity test from #2972 to these platforms. If the shape of recorded `platform_options` changes, it touches results identity: published `result_id`s must not change, so check against the corpus first.

2026-10-17: SQLite `database_name` is now applied (#3048, 7959be931), but `tests/unit/cli/test_platform_options_reach_adapters.py` still lists it in `KNOWN_UNAPPLIED_OPTIONS`; remove that entry. The plan-option exemption (`plan_max_depth`, `plan_capture_timeout_seconds`) on the hand-written `from_config` platforms is the main remaining gap; shrink it as each platform forwards the options. Owner, 2026-10-15, Claude session e0e74e6b, question dialog: "Keep follow-up tracker items".
description:
These options are accepted but never reach the adapter:
- The hand-written `from_config` methods of emr-serverless, dataproc, dataproc-serverless, synapse-spark, fabric-spark and snowpark-connect do not forward `plan_max_depth` or `plan_capture_timeout_seconds`.
- SQLite parses `database_name` but never reads it.
- TimescaleDB `from_config` drops `service_url`.
- glue and dataproc-serverless register no platform options at all.

Separately, supplied options are lifted only in `get_platform_config`, not in the default builder. The default builder was left alone because `DatabaseConfig` has `extra="allow"`, so lifting there would change the recorded `platform_options` shape.
